contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Soldier and hut issue of 348-350, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Bust laureate cuirassed left holding globe. Obverse inscription: DN CONS[---]. Reverse description: Soldier walking right leading small figure from hut beneath tree. Reverse inscription: FELTEMPREPARATIO. In exergue: possibly TRS. Diameter: 22.7mm, Weight: 2.83gms, die axis: 7
